en_US: Mr. Fuego: Hmm?
A trainer, in my Ironworks?
Well thanks for stopping by!
I see that Gardenia’s gone and given
you the Forest Badge.
Oh? She said you could partner up
with Scyther over here?
All good with us. We’ve just finished
with the last haul of firewood for
the month, so you’re good to go!
But before that, I’d love to blaze
these Ironworks alive with a battle!
Mr. Fuego: That’s the spirit! Let’s
see if you can handle the heat!
Mr. Fuego: Gwahaha! Burned out by a
youngster... What a battle!
Scyther is yours to call
on out in the field.
Whenever a tree blocks your path, just
give a whistle.
It’ll come running to
Cut it down for you!
Mr. Fuego: Not ready? No shame
in that.
Come back when you’ve warmed up.
Mr. Fuego: You’d better be treating
Scyther well out there!
Scy, scy!
